category.title: Business category
category.description: Choose a simple Italian business category. Use 'all' only for category validation tests, not for production scraping. Supported examples: informatica, software, consulenza, marketing, alimentare, tessile, edilizia, immobiliare, ristorazione, trasporti, turismo, meccanica.

categories.title: Additional categories
categories.description: Optional extra categories to merge into the same dataset. Example: software, consulenza. Leave empty for a single-category run.

allCategories.title: Test all preset categories
allCategories.description: QA/testing option. When enabled, the Actor runs all preset categories. Combine it with 'Maximum results per category' set to 1 or 2 to validate which presets return data.

maxItemsPerCategory.title: Maximum results per category
maxItemsPerCategory.description: Optional QA/segmentation limit. Set to 1 or 2 when testing all categories. Leave empty or 0 for normal production scraping controlled by Maximum results.

maxItems.title: Maximum results
maxItems.description: Maximum number of companies to save overall. Listing-only runs are fast. Full-detail runs are slower because each company detail page must be opened.

includeDetails.title: Include company details
includeDetails.description: Enable this to enrich each company with VAT number, address, postal code and employee range when available. Detail enrichment is slower: based on current tests, about 100 companies with details are pushed to the dataset in roughly 1 minute. For large full-detail runs, increase the Actor run timeout and memory in Run options.

includeWebsiteContacts.title: Try website contact enrichment
includeWebsiteContacts.description: Optional advanced enrichment. If a real company website is found, the Actor can try to inspect it for public emails, PEC and phone numbers. This slows runs down and often returns few results because aziende.it rarely exposes company websites.

startUrls.title: Advanced category URLs
startUrls.description: Optional. Add specific aziende.it category URLs if you want to bypass the simple category presets.
